payload.title: Santorini Wedding Packages and What They Include
payload.excerpt: Santorini wedding packages share a name and very little else.
key_takeaways: A Santorini venue package usually covers the ceremony space, its set-up, a coordinator and fixed hours, and everything else depends on the venue.
Food and drink, guest rooms and room-night minimums are often priced or required outside the package itself, so ask for each in writing.
Some Santorini venues require a wedding planner on top of the venue fee, which changes what a package is really worth to you.
Compare quotes on the same guest count, spaces, hours, nights, music times and currency before paying a deposit that may not be refundable.

faq.q: Are Santorini wedding packages all inclusive?
faq.a: Rarely. A package covers what its list names. Canaves keeps food and drink separate, and Andronis arranges extras such as an officiant and florals at an additional charge. Treat any package as the core of the day and ask for every extra in writing.

faq.q: What is included in a Santorini wedding package for two?
faq.a: It depends on the venue. The Canaves elopement package for a couple includes up to 5 hours of private use, event planning services, recorded music, a sparkling wine toast, a basic set-up and a two-tier cake. The Andronis package adds a private cliffside ceremony area, flowers, cake, sparkling wine and a turndown.

faq.q: Do Santorini wedding packages include accommodation?
faq.a: Some do, and some require it. Santorini Gem's overnight package includes its villa for the couple and villa guests. Canaves packages often require a set number of rooms for at least three nights. Grace Hotel sets no minimum number of rooms.

faq.q: Can a Santorini package work for around 50 guests?
faq.a: Yes, at several venues. Grace Hotel sets its venue fee inclusions either side of 50 guests, and Canaves Epitome has a package for 26 to 45 guests on the Sunset Terrace and Elements Restaurant, and a larger one with the pool area added for 45 to 100. The rooms you must book there rise with each guest band, so ask which band your number falls in.

faq.q: Does a venue package include the legal paperwork?
faq.a: Some venues include it in their package. At others, such as Canaves, preparation of the wedding documents is an option to request, so ask each venue what is covered and which fees sit outside its price.

faq.q: Can Australians legally marry in Santorini?
faq.a: Yes. Canaves lists civil and religious ceremonies among its ceremony types, and a marriage valid where it took place, and valid under Australian law, is in most cases recognised in Australia. You may need a Certificate of No Impediment, so prepare documents well ahead.
